title: External link
description: Marks a link as external: opens it in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" and adds a ↗ icon.

newTab.description: Open in a new tab. On by default; `newTab="false"` keeps the link in the same tab.

icon.description: Append the ↗ icon. On by default; `icon="false"` leaves it off.

_metadata.derivedFrom: src/wb-viewmodels/helpers.js — every property here is one the behavior reads
